basic_info.description: Stylish, semi-attached, three-bedroom, two-bath home with updated finishes, serene outdoor space, and located in an ideal Bernal Heights location! The main level offers an open living/dining space with wood floors, eat-in kitchen, sophisticated finishes, two bedrooms, a bathroom, laundry area, and all flooded with plenty of natural light. The upper level of the home has a spacious and third bedroom with ample closet space and a recently updated bathroom that is perfectly positioned for privacy. The unique front yard offers the perfect separation from the street and the winning combination of low maintenance mature landscaping, a potential gardener's paradise, perfect setting for entertainment, or peaceful and private relaxation. Don't miss this special Bernal Heights property located on a flat street near shopping, restaurants, cafes, restaurants, parks, HWY 101/280 and more!
